answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities unprofitable. Each agent pays a non-refundable fee equal to twice its expected 30-day reward to join. Like entering an orchard, one honest agent pays once and harvests its share; a forger pays for every tree claimed. A registry lists each fee, so a spiral of new names is visible, like a plume of smoke from one fire. 100 fakes cost 100 fees, more than they can steal, so honest earnings stay undiluted.
